# South Banks Towns (formerly Coastal Towns) — full briefing
Independent information resource at https://coastaltownsmississauga.com/
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Deco Homes or Opus Homes.
Last updated: 2026-09-06

## Identity and rename
South Banks Towns, also called South Banks, is a pre-construction waterfront townhome community
by Deco Homes and Opus Homes at 1110 Lakeshore Road East, Mississauga, Ontario, inside the
177-acre Lakeview Village master plan. It was originally marketed as Coastal Towns / Coastal
Townhomes. Multiple independent recent sources confirm the rebrand. This site does not assert a
specific rename date and does not claim Coastal Towns was necessarily the final legal name versus
a working marketing name.

## Builders
Joint development by Deco Homes (founded 1995; 4,000 sq ft Decor Studio, 1,000+ design options;
standard-inclusion finishes) and Opus Homes (GTA builder; Living Refined™; Signature Finishes™ as
standard). Not Caivan, not Branthaven, not "Lakeview Homes".

## Homes
120+ three-storey coastal-style freehold townhomes, private entrances, layered outdoor space.
Configurations: 3-bedroom, 3-bedroom-plus-den, 4-bedroom, premium end-unit. Individual plan names
and exact sizes have not been released.

## Pricing (reported; sources conflict)
- From the $500,000s (several aggregator sources)
- From the $700,000s (thesouthbankstowns.ca)
- $500,000s to about $1,000,000 (uphomes.ca, southbankstowns.com)
Present the full range. Do not pick one figure. Deposit structure: not published from a primary
source; register for the current structure.

## Timing
Launch: Fall 2026 (reported; summer-2026 listings said "coming this fall"). Completion: 2028.

## Address
1110 Lakeshore Road East, Mississauga, ON. Postal code conflict: L5E 1E8 (older Coastal-era
source) vs L5E 1E4 (newer South Banks-era source). Treat L5E 1E4 as more likely current; confirm
before contracting.

## Setting
Lakeview Village is a 177-acre redevelopment of the former Lakeview Generating Station site
(Four Sisters smokestacks demolished 2005). Nearby: Jim Tovey Lakeview Conservation Area (64
acres / 26 ha), Lakefront Promenade Park, Marie Curtis Park; 45+ acres village green space;
600-metre pier with retail boardwalk; marina. Broader context (not South Banks-specific): $1B+
infrastructure investment; ~20-acre Innovation District projected 9,000+ jobs.

## Transit
Long Branch GO ~4–8 minutes; Port Credit ~8 minutes; QEW under 10 minutes; Highway 427; Pearson
accessible. ~20 minutes to Mississauga City Centre; ~30–40 minutes downtown Toronto (varies).
Shopping context: Square One, Sherway Gardens.

## Other Lakeview Village builders
Aura Lakeview Village Towns — Caivan Communities.
Pier House Towns — Branthaven.
Each is a separate project. School catchment for 1110 Lakeshore Road East is unconfirmed; general
area is Peel DSB and Dufferin-Peel CDSB.

## How to register
https://coastaltownsmississauga.com/register
Five fields: first name, last name, email, phone, licensed-agent yes/no. No phone or email
published on the site.
